note: missing required deliverable (retrial-application.md) -> score 0; each extra file directly under the delivery root -> one DX_DELIVERABLE instance (0.4, cap 2). Subdirectories are never extras. The harness manifest.json is allow-listed because every harnessed delivery carries it.

source_dump.note: a run of >= 500 normalized characters copied verbatim from a materials file is one DX_SOURCE_DUMP instance (0.4, cap 2). Golden's own longest verbatim run is 0, and ordinary quotation stays far below the threshold, so quoting stays free.

min_length.note: Golden is 3552 normalized characters. The 0.75 floor separates a materially truncated filing from a concise but substantively complete application; section-specific shape is measured separately by D08.

language.brief: Write the retrial application in Chinese and save it as `artifacts/retrial-application.
language.note: Measured as the share of script-bearing characters (Han vs Latin letters). Golden retrial-application.md measures 0.991; a document in the other script measures under 0.06, so 0.5 separates the two.
